name: clone-terraria
description: Original-assets Terraria-style 2D sandbox. Vanilla JS + Canvas, no build step required to play.

scripts.validate: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:build && npm run test:browser

comment: The game itself runs from index.html with plain script tags (file:// or any static server). These scripts only drive validation. All --test arguments use globs because bare directory args are unreliable across supported Node versions/platforms.
